svg.text: central_bias: one input current (ibias0, SOURCED into IB_IN by the harness) -> the four bias currents of pgia_top by ratio (calibrated: the mirrors deliver ~1.26x their drawn ratio).

NMOS reference MN_R (m=10). Sinks (pins of PMOS-diode references): IB_IA m=33, IB_BUF m=11. MN_P (m=8) pulls the PMOS reference MP_R (m=10) whose m=9 mirrors SOURCE IB_G1 / IB_G2 (pins of NMOS-diode references).
With ibias0 = 1.0 uA: IA 4.4 uA, buffer 1.47 uA, stages 1.08 uA each (targets 4.2 / 1.4 / 1.0 / 1.0). scripts/verify_central_bias.py proves the whole chip with it.
